title: Tue 24 Nov · morning check
summary:
[b]Overnight:[/b] Wall Street held Monday's surge into the close (S&P +4.7%, VIX ~26.6); Fed December hike still ~95–96%; oil −4.5% (WTI ~$80) after the Iran-strike pause; Tokyo reopened quietly (USDJPY ~159); AUD near an 11-month low. No score changes; risk-on conditions for AUD, NZD and JPY now met on a close.
[b]Today:[/b] German Ifo 11:00, BoE Greene 14:30, US consumer confidence 17:00, BoC Macklem 19:40; Wed 25 Nov Australia CPI 02:30, US GDP + PCE 15:30.

USD.note: December Fed hike ~95–96% priced after Monday's equity surge; 2-year 4.70%; no Fed voice turned patient.

EUR.note: No CMP deal or spread print; Macron's fiscal golden-rule idea is context only; oil lower again helps the importer.

GBP.note: No MPC remarks since Pill; Greene 14:30 is the next test; equities rebounded, the opposite of the weakening condition.

JPY.note: Yen-weakening condition 'sharp risk-on rebound' now met on a close (S&P +4.7%); Tokyo reopened, no MoF comment; shadow unchanged.

CHF.note: VIX closed ~26.6 (from 35.9): not above 30, not yet under the 25 line of the franc-weakening condition.

CAD.note: WTI −4.5% to ~$80, Brent ~$89 on the Iran-strike pause; no written US–Canada deal; Macklem 19:40.

AUD.note: Aussie 'risk-on rebound' condition met on the close, but AUDUSD near an 11-month low with cuts priced; CPI Wed 02:30.

NZD.note: Carried: strong Q3 retail plus a risk-on close; no NZ news overnight; shadow unchanged (MEDIUM release).

XAU.note: Gold +2.7% to ~$3,635 is price context only; no ETF, central-bank or real-yield data; G +1.
